title: FloodGuard Rate Manual — Tier Rating Figures
content:
Rate manual page for the FloodGuard Private Flood Policy: the figures each tier contributes to the premium, the renewal rate cap and midterm premium changes.

| Tier | Building rate factor (multiplier) | Contents rate per 1,000 USD of contents limit (USD a year) | Elevation credit percentage | Companion discount percentage | Zone VE surcharge percentage | Minimum annual premium (USD) | Renewal rate cap percentage | Minimum premium change (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FloodGuard Contents Only | 0.00 | 1.18 | 0% | 5% | 0% | 125.00 | 18% | 5.00 |
| FloodGuard Essential | 1.00 | 1.18 | 0% | 5% | 0% | 225.00 | 18% | 5.00 |
| FloodGuard Standard | 1.04 | 1.24 | 10% | 5% | 0% | 250.00 | 15% | 5.00 |
| FloodGuard Plus | 1.09 | 1.31 | 10% | 7% | 20% | 300.00 | 15% | 5.00 |
| FloodGuard Premier | 1.15 | 1.39 | 15% | 7% | 20% | 375.00 | 12% | 5.00 |
| FloodGuard High Value | 1.22 | 1.47 | 15% | 10% | 15% | 500.00 | 10% | 0.00 |

## Definitions of the columns

- **Building rate factor** — the tier's multiplier applied to the zone building rate.
- **Contents rate per 1,000** — the annual contents premium for each 1,000 USD of contents limit.
- **Elevation credit percentage** — the building premium credit when an elevation certificate shows the lowest floor at least one foot above base flood elevation.
- **Companion discount percentage** — the discount when the same building is insured under a live HomeGuard, CondoGuard, RentGuard or LandlordGuard policy.
- **Zone VE surcharge percentage** — the surcharge on the building premium for a building in zone VE.
- **Minimum annual premium** — the smallest annual premium, before the policy fee.
- **Renewal rate cap percentage** — the largest renewal premium increase over the expiring term premium, excluding the policy fee.
- **Minimum premium change** — midterm prorated premium changes below this amount are not billed.

## Worked reading (hypothetical limits)

A hypothetical contents limit of 40,000 USD on FloodGuard Standard gives a contents premium of 40 multiplied by 1.24, which is 49.60 USD a year; on FloodGuard High Value the same limit gives 40 multiplied by 1.47, which is 58.80 USD. The building rate factor of 0.00 on FloodGuard Contents Only reflects that no building is insured on that tier. A midterm prorated premium change of 4.99 USD is below the 5.00 USD minimum premium change of FloodGuard Contents Only through Premier and is not billed there; on FloodGuard High Value the minimum premium change is 0.00 USD.
